scope: All 14 pages of theory questions and the original integral question tables and blanks. This distribution file has no separate answer, working or marking sheet.

translation.font: Embedded matching Noto Serif KR and Noto Sans KR, including the matching italic style. Native scientific Latin and numerical glyphs preserve their source faces, including charges and subscripts. All original embedded font programs are retained.
translation.layouts: Original geometry, figures, tables, page codes and native rule alignment of the eight bold italic answer blanks.
translation.map_labels: Main labels were localized. Original Lake Urmia, Mexico, and Philippines raster labels remain where their removal would cover the mapped distribution. The Urmia choice has a Korean caption.
translation.historical_periodic_table: 113 names and both series labels localized, with original symbols and masses, including temporary 2012 symbols.

qa.pixel_mask_note: The selected source and target text bounds include a 2.05 pt horizontal and 1.5 pt vertical margin for italic and outline overhang. Map coverage was also compared pixel for pixel inside the label regions.

source_edition: IJSO Brasil authentic Portuguese contestant edition
